note: Leaves the user fills after build_baseline and after the forecaster's operating path. Values here are notes, not facts about any company. The forecaster does not set rates.gt.

year.note: How many years to forecast before the terminal year. 10 is a common assumption, not a fact.

rates.rd.note: Cost of debt, decimal. Required on the EBITDA path. Take it from a stated rate or label an assumption.

rates.t.note: Marginal tax rate, decimal. The US federal statutory rate is only an assumption until a source says otherwise.

rates.gt.note: Terminal growth. Finagle's default is the 10-year yield, and it must stay below the cost of equity. The forecaster never sets this.

baseline.nol.note: Net operating loss, millions. Not filled by the SEC or yfinance helpers. Use the filing or an explicit assumption. Zero only if you mean zero.

baseline.noa.note: Non-operating assets, millions. Same rule as nol.

forecast.dwc.mode.note: zero or path. Silence is an assumption and has to be labeled. path needs one value per year, including the baseline.

distribution.mode.note: none, max_buybacks, buyback_schedule, or retain. none pays free cash flow out as dividends and does no buybacks.

debt.mode.note: hold, path, or target. If you leave it empty, build_baseline re-borrows toward year-0 Debt/EBITDA. On a prior HROW run that default was worth about $12 a share versus holding the debt flat. Choose explicitly. target also needs leverage and start_year; path needs values.
